name: Firmware update recovery rehearsal

stages.title: Bind the hardware and update revision
stages.needs: Device matrix, bootloader/partition design, firmware revisions and update manifest.
stages.work: Record exact hardware, bootloader and firmware versions, supported paths, trust boundaries, required log/health signals and physical recovery access. Flag unknown compatibility or signing/boot-confirm assumptions without requesting secret key values.
stages.gate: Unknown required compatibility or recovery facts block affected test cases.

stages.title: Specify the recovery rehearsal
stages.needs: Accepted inventory and the user's available lab capabilities.
stages.work: Plan interrupted download/write, truncated or wrong-target images, invalid signatures, failed first boot, watchdog/reset loops and missing healthy confirmation. Include stale/offline devices, duplicate or expired commands and each hardware revision. Define expected safe state and observable recovery evidence per case.
stages.hands: Test matrix with case ID, revision, expected transition, recovery path and evidence needed.
stages.gate: A case with no safe recovery path is BLOCKED. Planning is allowed without executing the lab.

stages.title: Run authorized lab checks or assess supplied evidence
stages.needs: The test matrix, a safe lab and applicable authorization, or actual supplied test records.
stages.work: Flash, fault-inject or change device state only when specifically authorized and the relevant lab/recovery tools are available. Otherwise assess supplied records or return the runnable plan. Never treat a simulation as proof of physical recovery. Reject incomplete/invalid images before marking bootable; assess rollback and boot-confirm results per hardware revision.
stages.hands: Revision-bound PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED register with actual logs/artifacts.
stages.gate: Unrun, failed or incomplete recovery evidence blocks a rollout-ready conclusion.

stages.title: Prepare a hardware-diverse canary proposal
stages.needs: Evidence register and user-defined rollout goals/thresholds.
stages.work: Propose representative cohorts, observation/health windows, offline-device handling and halt/rollback owners. Replace source example percentages and timings with fleet-specific values to agree. Widening a rollout, distributing firmware or changing policy is a separate authorized action.
stages.hands: Canary plan, acceptance/stop conditions, owners and unresolved decision list.
stages.gate: No rollout is described as approved or executed without applicable authorization and real evidence.

completion: All applicable stage inputs, outputs and blocking checks accepted with real evidence.
